decks.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Half Bridge DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 1 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n11 for R_SNUB:neg -> C_SNUB:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=39 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.05 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=2e-08 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Center-tapped Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
* NOTE: Rct is a HIGH-impedance resistor (typically 100meg-1gig Ohms) that provides DC bias
* for the secondary side to prevent SPICE singular matrix / convergence failures.
* It does NOT break electrical isolation - leakage current is negligible (~1pA).
.subckt Xctfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 CT params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K1=0.99 K2=0.99 K12=0.99 Rwp=0.1 Rws1=0.05 Rws2=0.05 Rcore=1e12 Cww1=5e-11 Cww2=5e-11 Rct=100meg
Rwp P1 P1a {Rwp}
Rws1 S1 S1a {Rws1}
Rws2 S2 S2a {Rws2}
Lp P1a P2 {Lm}
Ls1 S1a CT {Lm*Ns*Ns}
Ls2 S2a CT {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1 Lp Ls1 {K1}
K2 Lp Ls2 {K2}
K12 Ls1 Ls2 {K12}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww1 P1a S1a {Cww1}
Cww2 P1a S2a {Cww2}
Rct CT 0 {Rct}
.ends Xctfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 PWL(0 0 0.0001 48)
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.1
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n4 n2 n2 nmos_model
VSW2_SENSE n2 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n5 0 0 nmos_model
VD1_SENSE n2 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n0 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE 0 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp n2 Dmodel
VC1_SENSE n0 n_C1_sense 0
LC1_ESL n_C1_sense n_C1_esl 1e-10
RC1_ESR n_C1_esl n_C1_esr 0.05
C1 n_C1_esr n3 0.00047 IC=0
RC1_LEAK n0 n3 1e+11
VC2_SENSE n3 n_C2_sense 0
LC2_ESL n_C2_sense n_C2_esl 1e-10
RC2_ESR n_C2_esl n_C2_esr 0.05
C2 n_C2_esr 0 0.00047 IC=24
RC2_LEAK n3 0 1e+11
VT1_SENSE_PRI n2 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC1 n6 n_T1_s1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC2 n7 n_T1_s2_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n3 n_T1_s1_sense n_T1_s2_sense n9 Xctfmr Lm=0.0005 Ns=0.8 K1=0.98 K2=-0.98 K12=-0.98 Rwp=0.1 Rws1=0.1 Rws2=0.1 Rcore=1e+06 Cww1=5e-11 Cww2=5e-11 Rct=1e+08 Cct=0
R_SNUB n2 n11 220
C_SNUB n11 n3 2.2e-09
R_ISO n9 0 1e+08
VDR1_SENSE n6 n_DR1_sense 0
RDR1_SENSE_DAMP n_DR1_sense n_DR1_damp 0.001
DR1 n_DR1_damp n8 Dmodel
VDR2_SENSE n7 n_DR2_sense 0
RDR2_SENSE_DAMP n_DR2_sense n_DR2_damp 0.001
DR2 n_DR2_damp n8 Dmodel
VL_OUT_SENSE n8 n_L_OUT_sense 0
RL_OUT_ESR n_L_OUT_sense n_L_OUT_ser 0.2
L_OUT n_L_OUT_ser n10 2.2e-05
CL_OUT_par n8 n10 1e-12
VC_OUT_SENSE n10 n_C_OUT_sense 0
LC_OUT_ESL n_C_OUT_sense n_C_OUT_esl 1e-10
RC_OUT_ESR n_C_OUT_esl n_C_OUT_esr 0.5
C_OUT n_C_OUT_esr n9 0.00047 IC=0
RC_OUT_LEAK n10 n9 2.5e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n10 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n9 10
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int n2 PULSE(0 12 0 5e-07 5e-07 4.5e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n4 10
VPWM2 n_PWM2_int 0 PULSE(0 12 5.2e-06 5e-07 5e-07 4.5e-06 1e-05)
RPWM2_drive n_PWM2_int n5 10

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_startup: Startup transient from 0V to steady-state output voltage. Converter is NON-INVERTING half-bridge with center-tapped secondary rectification. Measure VOUT at [R_LOAD, pos] or [C_OUT, pos] (positive output terminal). Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let vout_steady_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_steady avg vout_steady_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_steady
let vout_peak_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_peak max vout_peak_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_peak
let VOUT_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran t_settle TRIG AT=1e-07 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=11.5 CROSS=LAST
print t_settle
let VDS_SW1_csv_diff = v(n0) - v(n2)
let VDS_SW1 = VDS_SW1_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VDS_SW1.csv VDS_SW1_csv_diff
let VDS_SW2 = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VDS_SW2.csv v(n2)
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let v_SW1_auto = v(n0) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW1.csv v_SW1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW1.csv i(VSW1_SENSE)
let v_SW1_gate_auto = v(n4) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW1.csv v_SW1_gate_auto
let v_SW2_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_SW2.csv v_SW2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW2.csv i(VSW2_SENSE)
let v_SW2_gate_auto = v(n5)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW2.csv v_SW2_gate_auto
let v_D1_auto = v(n2) - v(n0)
wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_D2_auto = 0 - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_D2.csv v_D2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D2.csv i(VD2_SENSE)
let v_C1_auto = v(n0) - v(n3)

let v_C2_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_C2.csv v_C2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_C2.csv i(VC2_SENSE)

let v_DR2_auto = v(n7) - v(n8)

wrdata time_series/I_DR2.csv i(VDR2_SENSE)
let v_L_OUT_auto = v(n8) - v(n10)
wrdata time_series/V_L_OUT.csv v_L_OUT_auto

* Transient Requirement tr_line_regulation: Line regulation test: Input voltage step from nominal to high line. Measure output voltage deviation and recovery time. Converter maintains regulation across input voltage range.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let VOUT_LINE_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_before find VOUT_LINE_diff at=0.013749999999999998
print vout_before
let vout_after_min_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_after_min min vout_after_min_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_after_min
let vout_after_steady_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_after_steady avg vout_after_steady_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_after_steady
let VOUT_LINE_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran t_recovery TRIG AT=1e-07 TARG VOUT_LINE_diff VAL=11.399999999999999 CROSS=LAST
print t_recovery
let VOUT_LINE_csv_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
let VOUT_LINE = VOUT_LINE_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_line_regulation_VOUT_LINE.csv VOUT_LINE_csv_diff

wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n5)
plot VOUT_LINE_csv_diff title 'tr_line_regulation_VOUT_LINE'
plot PWM1_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'

* Transient Requirement tr_load_transient: Load transient response: Step load change from light to heavy load. Measure output voltage undershoot/overshoot and recovery time. Verify output filter (L_OUT, C_OUT) provides adequate transient response.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let VOUT_LOAD_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_before_load find VOUT_LOAD_diff at=0.013749999999999998
print vout_before_load
let vout_min_load_diff = v(n10) - v(n9)
meas tran vout_min_load min vout_min_load_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
